description: Tests that v1.0 createSurface permits omitting catalogId.
name: test_v10_create_surface_optional_catalog_id

description: Tests v1.0 createSurface with metadata and extension descriptors.
name: test_v10_create_surface_with_metadata_extensions

description: Tests that v1.0 createSurface rejects metadata extensions whose key is not a Unicode identifier (UAX 31).
name: test_v10_create_surface_metadata_extension_key_must_be_identifier

description: Tests that v1.0 createSurface rejects metadata keys other than extensions.
name: test_v10_create_surface_metadata_only_holds_extensions

description: Tests that individual components in v1.0 can specify a catalogId override different from the surface default.
name: test_v10_component_catalog_override

description: Tests that updating a path with value null deletes the key from the data model in v1.0.
name: test_v10_update_data_model_deletion

description: Tests generating v1.0 renderer capabilities structure.
name: test_v10_get_renderer_capabilities

description: Tests that v1.0 inline catalogs list each component as a plain schema, without the v0.9 ComponentCommon allOf envelope, because v1.0 applies ComponentCommon at the message envelope, and advertise both unions that catalog_definition.json requires, with an empty one as not {}.
name: test_v10_get_renderer_capabilities_inline_catalogs

description: Tests that sending a single message envelope containing multiple update actions raises a ValidationError.

expectError.message: Message contains multiple conflicting update actions

name: test_multiple_update_types_error

description: Tests that message processor correctly processes message list arrays and wrapped container payloads.
name: test_batch_message_array_and_wrapper

description: Tests that v1.0 MessageProcessor rejects v0.8 beginRendering action when protocolVersion is v1.0.

expectError.message: action 'beginRendering' is not supported in protocol version 1.0

name: test_v10_rejects_v08_begin_rendering_action

description: Tests that a v1.0 action with a non-string surfaceId raises a ValidationError.
name: test_v10_non_string_surface_id_error

description: Tests that updating a component with a catalog of a different protocol version raises CatalogError.
name: test_v10_update_components_mismatched_catalog_protocol_version_error

description: Verifies rejecting unsupported protocol version strings (v99.0).
name: test_unsupported_protocol_version_error

description: Verifies processing messages with version v0.9.1.
name: test_v091_version_string_compatibility

description: Verifies ValidationError on missing version field during process_messages.
name: test_missing_version_field_in_v10_process_messages_error

description: Verifies create, component update, data update, and component mutation within a single batch array.
name: test_batch_multi_stage_lifecycle_pipeline

description: Verifies IntegrityError on duplicate component IDs within a single updateComponents message.
name: test_batch_duplicate_component_ids_in_same_message_error

description: Verifies candidate topology pre-flight cycle check aborts without mutating existing valid component tree.
name: test_batch_atomic_rollback_on_candidate_topology_cycle

description: Verifies updating components on a deleted surface raises IntegrityError.
name: test_update_components_on_deleted_surface_error

description: Verifies updating data model on a deleted surface raises IntegrityError.
name: test_update_data_model_on_deleted_surface_error

description: Verifies deleting a non-existent surface ID executes cleanly as a no-op.
name: test_delete_non_existent_surface_is_safe_noop

description: Verifies strictMode false accepts components unreachable from root.
name: test_permissive_mode_allows_orphan_components

description: Verifies strictMode false accepts containers referencing uncreated child IDs.
name: test_permissive_mode_allows_dangling_references

description: A strict processor accepts an orphan component in a call whose validationConfig allows orphans, and rejects one in the next call, which has no validationConfig.
name: test_v10_call_validation_config_relaxes_strict_processor

description: A processor created without validation rules rejects an orphan component in a call whose validationConfig is strict, and accepts one in the next call, which has no validationConfig.
name: test_v10_call_validation_config_tightens_permissive_processor

description: A call whose validationConfig allows only orphans still rejects a dangling child reference, since the rules it leaves out are strict, even on a processor created without validation rules.
name: test_v10_call_validation_config_leaves_out_rules_as_strict

description: Verifies updating container property without redefining children preserves existing child relationships.
name: test_composition_constraints_preserved_on_partial_parent_update

description: Verifies object nesting exceeding limit (>50) raises RecursionError.
name: test_global_recursion_depth_limit_exceeded_error

description: A component that names no catalogId on a surface that names no default catalog cannot be resolved, so the update fails instead of falling back to the first registered catalog.
name: test_v10_component_without_catalog_id_on_surface_without_default_errors

description: A surface without a default catalog accepts components that each name their catalog.
name: test_v10_components_naming_catalogs_on_surface_without_default

description: A component's catalogId belongs to the component envelope (ComponentCommon), not to its properties. A catalog whose component schema is closed and declares no catalogId accepts a component that names that catalog.
name: test_v10_component_from_named_catalog_with_closed_schema_accepted

description: Under strictMode: true (allow_unknown_elements=False), a function call that names a catalogId is validated against that catalog's function schema, which does not declare formatString. With strictMode: false, the call is accepted at processing time so a renderer can route it via callAgentFunction.
name: test_v10_function_call_naming_catalog_without_that_function_errors

description: A function call that names a catalogId has its args validated against that catalog's function definition.
name: test_v10_function_call_naming_catalog_with_invalid_args_errors

description: A component from the surface default catalog may call a function from another catalog by naming its catalogId.
name: test_v10_function_call_naming_catalog_with_valid_args

description: Under strictMode: true, a function call that names no catalogId is checked against the surface default catalog, and a function that catalog declares without an implementation (schema-only, as for a function that runs on the agent) passes. Strict validation rejects only functions no catalog declares; a renderer that validates strictly can declare the agent's functions this way and still route calls to them via callAgentFunction.
name: test_v10_strict_function_call_to_schema_only_function_of_surface_catalog

description: A function call that names a catalogId the client does not have is rejected.
name: test_v10_function_call_naming_unknown_catalog_errors

description: A function call whose catalogId is an empty string names a catalog, so it does not fall back to the surface default. No catalog has an empty ID, so the call is rejected.
name: test_v10_function_call_with_empty_catalog_id_errors

description: A component's catalogId must be a string. A number is rejected as invalid instead of being ignored, which would resolve the component to the surface default.
name: test_v10_component_with_non_string_catalog_id_errors

description: A function call that names no catalogId resolves against the surface default catalog, not the catalog of the component that contains it. formatString is declared by the basic catalog only.
name: test_v10_function_call_without_catalog_id_uses_surface_default

description: Under strictMode: true (allow_unknown_elements=False), a function call that names no catalogId is validated against the surface default catalog's function schema, which does not declare notAFunction. With strictMode: false, the call is accepted at processing time so a renderer can route it via callAgentFunction.
name: test_v10_function_call_without_catalog_id_to_unknown_function_errors

description: A function call that names no catalogId on a surface without a default catalog cannot be resolved, even when the component's own catalog declares the function.
name: test_v10_function_call_without_catalog_id_on_surface_without_default_errors

description: @index is a universal system function that belongs to no catalog, so a template may call it without a catalogId on a surface that has no default catalog.
name: test_v10_index_function_on_surface_without_default

description: @index is accepted on a surface whose default catalog is the basic catalog; it is not looked up as a catalog function.
name: test_v10_index_function_on_surface_with_default

description: An update that names no catalogId resolves against the surface default, not the catalog of the component's earlier version, so it fails on a surface without a default catalog.
name: test_v10_component_update_without_catalog_id_on_surface_without_default_errors

description: An update that names no catalogId resolves against the surface default catalog even when the component's earlier version named another catalog. The basic catalog declares no Badge, so the update is rejected.
name: test_v10_component_update_without_catalog_id_uses_surface_default

description: A call nested in the args of another call resolves its catalog on its own and does not inherit the catalog of the call around it. The outer wrap names custom-v10; the inner shout names no catalogId, so it resolves to the surface default (the basic catalog), which under strictMode: true rejects shout because the basic catalog does not declare it.
name: test_v10_nested_call_in_args_resolves_its_own_catalog

description: A call nested in the args of another call is accepted when it names the catalog that declares it, even though the surface default (the basic catalog) does not declare it.
name: test_v10_nested_call_in_args_naming_its_catalog

description: On a surface without a default catalog, a call nested in the args of a call that names custom-v10 cannot be resolved when it names no catalogId itself, even though custom-v10 declares it.
name: test_v10_nested_call_in_args_on_surface_without_default_errors

description: @index needs no catalog, but a call in its args is still resolved and checked. Here the offset calls notAFunction, which under strictMode: true is rejected because the surface default (the basic catalog) does not declare it.
name: test_v10_call_in_index_args_is_checked

description: On a surface without a default catalog, @index itself is accepted, but a call in its args that names no catalogId cannot be resolved.
name: test_v10_call_in_index_args_on_surface_without_default_errors

description: Calls inside a list property, and inside objects nested in that list, are resolved one by one; each names custom-v10, which declares shout.
name: test_v10_calls_in_lists_naming_their_catalog

description: A call inside an object nested in a list property is resolved like any other call: it names no catalogId, so it resolves to the surface default (the basic catalog), which under strictMode: true rejects shout because the basic catalog does not declare it, even though the component and the list's first call use custom-v10.
name: test_v10_call_in_list_without_catalog_id_uses_surface_default

description: A call inside an object nested in a list property has its args checked against the catalog it names; custom-v10's shout requires a string phrase.
name: test_v10_call_in_list_with_invalid_args_errors

description: The @ namespace is reserved for system functions, and v1.0 defines only @index. A call to @foo is rejected rather than looked up in a catalog.
name: test_v10_undefined_system_function_errors

description: A function call's name must be a UAX #31 identifier. An empty name is not one, so the call is rejected rather than skipped.
name: test_v10_function_call_with_empty_name_errors

description: Catalog resolution does not depend on strict validation. With strictMode off, a call that names no catalogId on a surface without a default catalog is still rejected.
name: test_v10_call_without_catalog_id_on_surface_without_default_errors_without_strict_mode

description: Catalog resolution does not depend on strict validation. With strictMode off, a call that names a catalogId the client does not have is still rejected.
name: test_v10_call_naming_unknown_catalog_errors_without_strict_mode

description: With strictMode off (default renderer processing), a function call whose catalog resolves is accepted even when that local catalog does not declare the function, so the renderer can forward it to the agent via callAgentFunction.
name: test_v10_call_to_undeclared_function_without_strict_mode_accepted

description: Every catalog a v1.0 surface uses must be built for v1.0. A call that names v09-catalog, a v0.9 catalog the client has, cannot be resolved on a v1.0 surface. The message check only requires the error to name the catalog, since SDKs word the reason differently.
name: test_v10_call_naming_catalog_of_other_protocol_version_errors

description: A call's catalogId must be a string. A number is rejected as invalid instead of being ignored, which would resolve the call to the surface default.
name: test_v10_call_with_non_string_catalog_id_errors

description: A component that names a catalogId is validated against that catalog, not the surface default. custom-v10 declares no Text, although the default (the basic catalog) does.
name: test_v10_component_naming_catalog_is_checked_against_that_catalog

description: There is no fallback to the catalogs the client supports, even when the case supplies only one. A component that names no catalogId on a surface without a default catalog is rejected.
name: test_v10_component_without_catalog_id_errors_with_a_single_catalog

description: A v1.0 surface created without a default catalog keeps the protocol version of the message that created it, so it is part of a v1.0 data model request. Its data model is empty.
name: test_v10_get_renderer_data_model_includes_surface_without_default

description: A v1.0 surface created without a default catalog is not part of a v0.9 data model request, so the request finds no surface to report.
name: test_v10_get_renderer_data_model_excludes_surface_without_default_from_v09

description: With a v1.0 surface that has no default catalog and a v0.9 surface side by side, a v0.9 data model request reports only the v0.9 surface. The surfaces are created in separate steps, one batch per protocol version.
name: test_v10_get_renderer_data_model_filters_by_surface_protocol_version

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents keeps ComponentCommon.metadata apart from component properties and exposes it as component metadata.
name: test_v10_update_components_stores_component_metadata

description: Tests that a later v1.0 updateComponents entry replaces a component's metadata in full rather than merging it.
name: test_v10_update_components_replaces_component_metadata

description: Tests that a v1.0 updateComponents entry without metadata clears the component's previously stored metadata, because an update replaces the definition in full.
name: test_v10_update_components_omitted_metadata_clears_component_metadata

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents rejects component metadata extensions whose key is not a Unicode identifier (UAX 31) when the component is first created.
name: test_v10_update_components_metadata_extension_key_must_be_identifier

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents rejects an invalid UAX 31 extension key on an existing component and leaves the previously stored metadata untouched.
name: test_v10_update_components_metadata_extension_key_must_be_identifier_on_update

description: Multi-step strictMode: false incremental streaming case verifying that out-of-order child components arriving before root emit zero errors and assemble cleanly once root arrives.
name: test_v10_permissive_incremental_streaming_out_of_order_before_root

description: Tests that a v1.0 createSurface message carrying a theme property is rejected with a ValidationError in strict mode.
name: test_v10_create_surface_theme_rejected_strict

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents accepts @metadata on a component, stores it on ComponentModel.metadata, replaces it on subsequent updateComponents, and clears it when omitted.
name: test_v10_update_components_stores_at_prefixed_component_metadata

description: Tests that a v1.0 custom catalog component whose schema declares its own 'metadata', 'catalogId', 'accessibility', and 'checks' properties can receive those bare custom properties alongside @metadata and @accessibility envelope mixins without collision (#1376).
name: test_v10_at_prefixed_envelope_coexists_with_custom_component_properties

description: Tests that during the v1.0 transition a legacy bare 'catalogId' that the component's schema in the surface default catalog does not declare routes the component to the catalog it names, and is not kept as a property even when the component's schema in that catalog declares a 'catalogId' property of its own.
name: test_v10_legacy_catalog_id_routes_by_default_catalog_schema

description: Tests that during the v1.0 transition a legacy bare 'catalogId' that the component's schema in the surface default catalog does not declare routes the component to the catalog it names, and is not validated as the component's own 'catalogId' property there, even when that property is not a string.
name: test_v10_legacy_catalog_id_routes_when_target_declares_non_string_catalog_id

description: Tests that a v1.0 '@catalogId' routes a component to a catalog whose schema for it declares an optional 'catalogId' property of another type, which the payload omits. The routing catalog ID is not validated as that property.
name: test_v10_at_catalog_id_routes_when_target_declares_optional_custom_catalog_id

description: Tests that a v1.0 component whose schema declares an optional 'metadata' property of its own, which the payload omits, accepts and stores '@metadata' envelope metadata. The envelope metadata is not validated as that property.
name: test_v10_at_metadata_with_omitted_optional_custom_metadata_property

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents rejects a component whose '@catalogId' is null instead of resolving it to the surface default catalog.
name: test_v10_update_components_rejects_null_at_catalog_id

description: Tests that v1.0 updateComponents rejects a component whose legacy bare 'catalogId', which its schema doesn't declare as a property of its own, is null instead of resolving it to the surface default catalog.
name: test_v10_update_components_rejects_null_legacy_catalog_id

description: Tests that a v1.0 component whose schema declares its own 'metadata' in a 'oneOf' branch and its own 'catalogId' in an 'anyOf' branch, both nested in an 'allOf' member, keeps the bare 'metadata' and 'catalogId' as component properties alongside '@metadata' envelope metadata, without a conflict between the bare and '@' forms.
name: test_v10_custom_envelope_properties_declared_in_combiner_branches

description: Tests that during the v1.0 transition a bare 'catalogId' or 'metadata' declared inline in a component's 'properties' is the standard ComponentCommon mixin only when the same 'properties' block also declares 'id' and the property has the standard shape (a string 'catalogId', or an object 'metadata' whose only property is 'extensions'). Otherwise it is a property of the component, kept beside '@metadata' envelope metadata.
name: test_v10_inline_catalog_id_and_metadata_standard_only_beside_inline_id
